title: RadFusion: Benchmarking Performance and Fairness for Multimodal Pulmonary Embolism Detection from CT and EHR
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. The benchmark measures model performance and fairness for pulmonary embolism detection across demographic groups of gender, race, and age.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it was not a subject of the study.
